description: The file defines the pCache class responsible for caching rendered chart images to improve performance by storing pictures in cache files along with associated index data. It provides methods for cache management, such as writing to cache, retrieving, and removing cache entries.

classes.name: pCache
classes.description: A class for managing cached chart images, including storing, retrieving, and removing cache entries, as well as handling cache files and indexes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache object, setting cache folder and file names, and creating cache index and database files if they do not exist.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the entire cache by resetting index and database files.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash based on chart data and an optional marker for cache identification.

methods.name: writeToCache
methods.description: Stores a chart image in cache by writing the picture file and updating index records.

methods.name: removeOlderThan
methods.description: Removes cache entries older than a specified timestamp.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry identified by its ID.

methods.name: dbRemoval
methods.description: Removes cache entries based on specified criteria, such as expiry time or ID.

methods.name: isInCache
methods.description: Checks if a cache entry exists for a given ID, optionally updating hit count and returning detailed info.

methods.name: autoOutput
methods.description: Outputs cached image directly to browser or saves to disk depending on execution context.

methods.name: strokeFromCache
methods.description: Outputs cached image directly to browser.

methods.name: saveFromCache
methods.description: Saves cached image to a specified file.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves raw image data from cache by ID.
